summary: A Yes vote continues the city's existing 0.75% transactions and use (sales) tax, which is otherwise set to expire March 31, 2033.

tax.text: A Yes vote re-enacts a 0.75 percent sales tax to fund public safety, youth recreation, code enforcement, and other essential services.
tax.quote: To continue to enhance the health, safety and welfare of Greenfield, through strengthened public safety; increased youth recreation programs; continuance of code enforcement services; and other essential services, shall the City of Greenfield re-enact a voter approved 0.75 percent sales tax

tax.text: A No vote rejects re-enactment of the 0.75 percent sales tax.
tax.quote: To continue to enhance the health, safety and welfare of Greenfield, through strengthened public safety; increased youth recreation programs; continuance of code enforcement services; and other essential services, shall the City of Greenfield re-enact a voter approved 0.75 percent sales tax
